document.abstract: This survey of high-speed photographic equipment was compiled as a by-product of the planning for the photographic instrumentation of the new 1.75 million gallon hydroballistics facilities at the U.S. Naval Ordnance Laboratory in White Oak, Maryland. The cameras were surveyed at 124 locations. The work was done by David Fatora, a Photographic Technologist in the Photographic Division of the Laboratory.
